title: Callithamnion granulatum (Ducluzeau) C Agardh — National Museums Northern Ireland, Habitas
scope: Regional account; local occurrence is not native origin
selectedText:
Callithamnion granulatum — Regional account; local occurrence is not native origin.

Description: Thallus uniseriate in erect dense tufts to 15 cms long. Rhizoidal filaments form a thick cortex.

Habitat: Epiphytic, epilithic and epizoic in the lower littoral.

Distribution: Widely distributed in the British Isles. Further afield: Canary Islands.
